sentences.text: Chaman Lal vs . State on 11 April, 2025

Author: Jyotsna Rewal Dua
Bench: Jyotsna Rewal Dua
Chaman Lal Vs. State Cr.MP(M) No.2948/2024 11.04.2025 Present: Mr. Rajendera Gulati & Mr.
Suresh Saini, Advocates, for the petitioner.
Ms. Menka Raj Chauhan, Deputy Advocate General, for the respondent.
Notice.
Ms. Menka Raj Chauhan, learned Deputy Advocate General, accepts notice on behalf of the respondent.

2. Pending consideration of petitioner's regular bail prayed for in Cr.MP(M) No.2948/2023 in relation to FIR No. 88/2023 dated 25.10.2023 registered under Section 376(D), 342, 325, 120-B of the Indian Penal Code at Police Station Kandaghat, District Solan, Himachal Pradesh, petitioner through his father has now moved instant application under Section 528 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) for release on temporary bail.
3. Prayer for temporary bail has been made on the ground that petitioner's grand-mother has left for heavenly abode on 10.04.2025;
Her last rites are to be performed by the petitioner being her grand-son.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner is resident of Village Ugar Kando, Post Office Jarag, Tehsil Sangrah, District Sirmour, H.P; Petitioner has immovable and movable properties in the aforesaid village besides deep-roots in the society.
5.

Learned Deputy Advocate General submits that she has telephonically confirmed the fact from MHC Pankaj Thakur, No.42, Police Station Kandaghat, who has verified and affirmed the facts pleaded in the application about death of petitioner's grand-mother on 09.04.2025.
6. Application is supported with the certificate dated 10.04.2025 issued by Pradhan Gram Panchayat Ugar Kando, Tehsil Sangrah, District Sirmour.
The Pradhan Gram Panchayat has certified that petitioner's grand-mother has died and further that petitioner's presence is required for performing her last rites.
The Pradhan has also certified that the Gram Panchayat has no objection, in case, petitioner is granted temporary bail for the above purpose.
7. The Court cannot be oblivious to the fact that the petitioner being the grand-son has to perform the last rituals of his deceased grand-mother.

Accordingly, the petitioner is ordered to be taken in proper custody to his home at Village Ugar Kando, Post Office Jarag, Tehsil Sangrah, District Sirmour, H.P, for performing the last rites of his grand-mother by 8.00 A.M. on 12.04.2025.
The petitioner be brought back to the concerned Jail by 4.00 P.M. on 15.04.2025.

During the aforesaid Chaman Lal vs . State on 11 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/2453726/
1 period in question the petitioner shall restrict his activities only in performing last rites of his deceased grand- mother.
